bead.title: ADR-011 axon-esf v0.3.2 pin and domain decision
bead.description: Adopt axon-esf as a tagged git dependency and settle the pqueue domain/API decision required by ADR-011. In-scope files: Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, crates/pqueue-core/Cargo.toml, crates/pqueue-core/src/domain.rs, crates/pqueue-core/src/lib.rs, crates/pqueue/src/lib.rs if re-exports need changing. Use axon tag v0.3.2, not v0.3.0/v0.3.1 and not a path dependency. Add pqueue domain types that preserve name-based pqueue query ergonomics while wrapping axon_esf::IndexDeclaration, e.g. QueueIndex { name, declaration }. Add QueueDefinition entity_schema: Option<EntitySchemaDocument> and serde defaults. Keep legacy ADR-010 definitions readable or deliberately map/reject them with tests; do not silently drop existing secondary_indexes. Update create_queue validation for duplicate names, invalid index shapes, caps, and QueueDefinitionConflict when schema/index declarations differ. Out-of-scope: write-path validation and projection key maintenance.
bead.acceptance: cargo test -p pqueue-core core_domain_tests -- --nocapture passes; cargo tree -p pqueue-core | rg 'axon-core|axon-schema|axon-cypher-ast|reqwest|hyper|tower' returns no matches; rg 'path = .*axon|../axon|/Users/.*/axon' Cargo.toml crates/*/Cargo.toml returns no matches.
